_comment: Outcomes EXPECTED TODAY (s3dlio 0.9.114 wheel, GCS S3 endpoint). A call with no entry is expected to be ACTION=OK and RECORD=OK. Per call the report says PASS (matches OK/OK), KNOWN (defect reproduced exactly as listed), FIXED (listed defect gone), CHANGED (different failure than listed), NEW (failure with no entry). 'action'/'record' use the report's signature strings. 'issues' are github.com/russfellows/s3dlio issue numbers; 'seen' says whether this exact outcome was observed on the 0.9.114 wheel when the entry was written.

expected.note: every S3 GET/PUT is recorded twice: LoggedObjectStore row (endpoint s3://bucket, file bucket/key, empty client_id) + legacy S3Ops row (endpoint = AWS_ENDPOINT_URL, file = bare key, client_id = the access key id)
stat/get_range strip the leading '/' of the key and read the OTHER object (<prefix>/slash/x); the row still names the asked key
after get_async() created the logger-less cached store, a later sync delete writes no row
get_async() on a host-form URI writes no row
MultiEndpointStore get_range/list/delete write no row (get and put do produce one legacy S3Ops row: partial logging)
MultiEndpointStore dials a host-form :443 endpoint over plain http://; the failed call writes no row
delete_batch sends every key to the bucket of uris[0]: the bucket-B2 target survives, the same-key decoy in bucket B1 is deleted, Ok returned
sync get/get_range on a host-form URI hang forever (store not yet cached)
get_many ignores the host-form URI and uses the configured endpoint (here an unroutable decoy); the rows truthfully name that endpoint
s3://10.255.255.1/bucket/key: the host is ignored, the call goes to AWS_ENDPOINT_URL and succeeds; the LoggedObjectStore row names the host that was never contacted

process.note: intermittent SIGSEGV (exit 139) at interpreter exit after a failed MultiEndpointStore get (~50% of runs)

reported_but_not_reproduced_on_0.9.114.#171 stat (host-form :443): host443_decoydefault_stat: stat went to the host-form host on :443 over https (SDK log), correct object, 1 correct row
reported_but_not_reproduced_on_0.9.114.#171 get_async (host-form :443): host443_decoydefault_get_async: GetObject went to the host-form host on :443 over https; only the missing row (#174) is wrong
reported_but_not_reproduced_on_0.9.114.#175 MultiEndpointStore.get/put: multi_endpoint get/put DO produce one (legacy S3Ops-style) row each; only get_range/list/delete are silent
reported_but_not_reproduced_on_0.9.114.#189 exists() false: exists_missing writes a HEAD row WITH an error text (not a success row)

audit_unasked_deletions.note: the same-key decoy in the other bucket, deleted by delete_batch
